title: Aoun: South Won't Remain a 'Forgotten Region' or 'Bargaining Chip'
detail: Marking the 48th anniversary of the disappearance of Shiite cleric Imam Moussa al-Sadr, President Joseph Aoun said he refuses to let the South become a 'forgotten region' or a bargaining chip, and that only state-controlled weapons should legitimately protect Lebanese territory. Aoun said he is 'working to achieve what the disappeared imam wanted: a strong and just state and a South protected by its army, its security forces, and the resilience of its people and the state combined,' and pledged continued efforts to uncover the truth about al-Sadr's fate.

media.caption: President Joseph Aoun marks the anniversary of Imam Moussa al-Sadr's disappearance, Aug 30, 2026

title: Qassem: 'Resistance Will Ultimately Defeat the Enemy's Project'
detail: Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem warned that retreating under US and Israeli pressure would bring 'annihilation' to Iran, Hezbollah, their allies, and Muslims more broadly. He said that 'no matter what America and Israel do, no matter how severe the sanctions, and no matter how intense the military aggression, resistance will ultimately defeat the enemy's project,' arguing that continued opposition would halt Israel's advance.

media.caption: Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem addresses supporters, Aug 30, 2026
